newsitem.title: USA: Sonat has apparent East Texas natgas find.
newsitem.headline: Sonat has apparent East Texas natgas find.

text.p: Sonat Inc said Tuesday the Scurlock No. 1 well, located in the Bear Grass area of the Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef trend in Leon County, Texas, is an apparent natural gas discovery.
The company said it owns a 65 percent working interest in the well.

The Scurlock well encountered a Pinnacle Reef in the Cotton Valley Limestone at a depth of 14,330 feet and was drilled to a total depth of 14,732 feet, Sonat said. Completion activity on the Scurlock well will begin immediately.
Sonat said it expects the well will be tested and production commenced by late September.

Based on the excellent natural gas shows and very porous reservoir rock encountered in this interval, the company anticipates the well will result in a new discovery in this trend of prolific gas producers, its statement said.

Sonat said it is drilling a 100 percent working-interest-owned Blanton No. 1 exploratory well on another Pinnacle Reef prospect about two miles from the Scurlock well. Another exploratory test will be started by the company in this Bear Grass area by the end of September.
